title: Acyclic closed term for the dense-open counit
statement: Let k,k' be algebraically closed fields and f:X→Spec k a separated finite-type curve of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. Let X'→X be the pullback along Spec k'→Spec k [def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback]. For any commutative ring Λ, module sheaf F [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and dense open U, let A be its underlying abelian sheaf, and ε the underlying counit j_!j^*F→F [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. There exist an abelian sheaf B and b:A→B with εb=0 such that 0→G→A→B→0 is short exact, the canonical degree-zero cohomologyMap for B [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] is bijective, and H¹(X,B) and H¹(X',ι'^*B) are subsingletons. No torsion, reducedness, or constructibility assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Form the reduced closed complement i:Z→X and the module open-closed short exact sequence. Forget to abelian sheaves, an exact functor. Its first arrow is exactly ε; choose the last object B and last arrow b from this sequence.

Density excludes the generic points of the Noetherian curve. The closed complement is therefore finite and zero-dimensional, with residue fields k. Finite exact direct image and Leray identify cohomology of B with that on Z, which vanishes in positive degrees. After the field extension, finite-exchange base change for the closed immersion identifies the pulled-back B with the corresponding closed term on the finite union of k'-points. Its degree-one cohomology vanishes as well. The degree-zero canonical map is the product of stalk comparisons, and hence bijective. This works for arbitrary module stalks; finiteness of those stalks is not needed. Empty complements give the zero sheaf.

theorem dense_open_closed_term (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k']
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f]
    {ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of k')}
    {ι' : X' ⟶ X} (h : IsPullback ι' f' f ι)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) :
    let A := (sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F
    let ε := (sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
        ((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).counit.app F)
    ∃ (B : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (b : A ⟶ B)
      (w : ε ≫ b = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk ε b w).ShortExact ∧
      Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap ι' B 0) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H B 1) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (((ι')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj B) 1)
